by_cases hm : m = 0
· have h_sub : {n : ℕ | f n = 0} ⊆ {0, 1} := by
    intro n hn
    by_cases h2 : 2 ≤ n
    · exfalso
      have := one_le_f n h2
      rw [hn] at this
      norm_num at this
    · interval_cases n <;> simp
  exact finite_hasDensity_zero ((Set.toFinite {0, 1}).subset h_sub)
· refine finite_hasDensity_zero ?_
  refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Iic (m + 2)) ?_
  intro n hn
  by_contra! h
  have h3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
  have h_le := f_le_sub_two n h3

lemma finite_hasDensity_zero {s : Set ℕ} (hs : s.Finite) : s.HasDensity 0 := by
  rcases hs.exists_finset_subset with ⟨t, ht⟩
  unfold HasDensity
  have h_le : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, 0 ≤ ((s ∩ Finset.range n).card : ℝ) / n := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    positivity
  have h_upper : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, ((s ∩ Finset.range n).card : ℝ) / n ≤ (t.card : ℝ) / n := by
    filter_upwards with n
    gcongr
    intro x hx
    exact ht hx.1
  have h_zero : Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ (t.card : ℝ) / n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have : (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ (t.card : ℝ) / n) = (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ (t.card : ℝ) * (1 / n)) := by ext; ring
    rw [this]
    exact Tendsto.mul_const (t.card : ℝ) (tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_zero h_le h_upper
